grammar-de-adv-dev-cardinal-2x.explanation: The prompt distinguished Card from Mult semantically but did not state the official German-GSD digit-x ADV convention, so the model expanded the canonical written identity to the spelled-out multiplicative Lemma.

grammar-de-adv-dev-variant-bisschen.explanation: The prompt taught Ind for several quantitative ADV identities but did not make explicit that lemma-owned Core Features survive a licensed Surface spelling variant. The model dropped PronType only on the pre-reform variant.
